crossRefs.note: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned…
because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps…
For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they…
May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I…
The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will…
“Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for Yahweh is a God of…
For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who…
A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to…
He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his dwelling, those who dwell in heaven.

translations.web: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
translations.bsb: They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
translations.kjv: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
translations.asv: They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.
